name: Navigation clerk
design: Lean elderly male with pale silver reptilian hide, uneven brow and long exposed mandibles, white dreadlocks hanging mid-back. Long charcoal civilian coat with narrow bronze seams and a soft high neck wrap, slim leather belt carrying two navigation cylinders. Holds a closed thin metal chart folio in both hands before abdomen; slight stoop, calm observant face, sparse shin wraps and clawed feet.
